# Strategy and Operations Associate, YouTube Music and Premium

Company: YouTube
Tracker ID: fixture_youtube_strategy_operations_associate
Location: US
Work arrangement: On-site
Salary range: $124000 to $178000
Official source: Google Careers

## Job Description

The Strategy and Operations Associate supports YouTube Music and Premium priorities through
cross-functional planning, executive communication, operational projects, and structured problem
solving. The role works with Product, Marketing, partnerships, and leadership teams to maintain a
holistic view of partners and execute critical priorities.

Responsibilities include preparing executive-level presentations and partner reviews, supporting
annual planning and OKR processes, leading strategic and operational projects, identifying problems
across organizations, creating programs and processes, and influencing cross-functional teams.

Requirements include strategy and operations experience, executive stakeholder communication,
project management, analytical problem solving, sound business judgment, and an understanding of
music subscriptions and strategic partnerships.
